name: Soft tofu and egg stew
steps: Soften the garlic and kimchi in a little sesame oil in a small pot.
Stir in the gochujang and a splash of water to make a broth.
Spoon in the silken tofu in large chunks and simmer gently.
Crack the egg into the middle and let it poach for a minute.
Finish with the sliced green onion and serve bubbling hot.
